sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 5 (#4) and Internal Quality Checks row 5 (#4); Deterministic Checks C31 (runtime contract strings)
evidence: Runtime facts, each checked against what test.sh actually does: entry /app/server.js (instruction.md:5; integration.md:3; test.sh:68,97,111); start command 'Node 22 running /app/server.js as an ordinary user and not necessarily from inside /app' (integration.md:3; test.sh:99-111 runs uid 65534 and may run a /tmp/submission copy, which is why the brief says to resolve files relative to server.js); port 0.0.0.0:3000 (integration.md:3; test.sh:109, probe at :3000; app_context URL); storage SQLite /app/app.db honoring DB_PATH (instruction.md:5; integration.md:3; test.sh:98-101,109); exact env set PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME (may not be /app)/PORT/DB_PATH (integration.md:3 matches test.sh:104-109 env -i); health GET /api/health 200 even without DB (integration.md:3; test.sh:48 probe); restart persistence and import-once seeding (integration.md:5; functional persistence criterion); no symlinks in /app (integration.md:5; test.sh:72-83 is laxer, accepting node_modules-internal links, so the brief is stricter and safe); fixed clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z and UTC display (integration.md:7; seed clock; criteria figures); seed /assets/seed_data.json (instruction.md:5; Dockerfile COPY; task.toml artifacts); accounts and shared password123 with roles and the Dev/M-12 wall (walls-and-retention.md:3-15; app_context.md). Network is public, so nothing needs stating (integration.md:3 even permits CDN assets). Graded-vs-asked sweep over all 28 criteria found a public basis for every demand: signed-out no-data (instruction.md:7, integration.md:9); client scope and plain not-available (walls:15-17); wall on every route including suggestions, link previews, mentions, quotes, unread counts, transcripts, and a live wall within about 10 s (walls:17-19; conversations:17,21); cross-matter reply refusal (conv:5); nesting at 3+ levels in sent order with parent quote (conv:5); deleted/expired placeholder, exactly-7-day boundary, edits not making a message younger, shorten-deletes and off/lengthen not restoring, partner-only timers and holds, hold scope and release-then-expire, typed 'On hold' (walls:23-29; conv:9,13); edited mark, staff earlier versions, stale-edit refusal that keeps typed text, author-only edit/delete, delete confirmation (conv:9); safe formatting set and literal markup everywhere (conv:13); link preview, not-available, highlight that persists (conv:17); mention by first name in any case, @ suggestions scoped to the matter, mentions following edits and deletes (conv:21); per-user unread count identical across tabs, new-messages line, mark-unread, deleted messages not counted (conv:25); Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (conv:29); duplicate send appears once and same-time order stays consistent across thread, search and transcript (conv:31); live updates without losing draft, scroll or open thread (conv:33); 390 px width (conv:35); case-insensitive literal substring search with no earlier versions and click-to-open (walls:33); transcript heading, oldest first in threads, author, sent time, edited mark, hold mark, versions of a held edited message, placeholder, no chat controls, access only for people who can see the matter (walls:35); refusal reason shown in place and persisting (walls:37). Adversarial probes: (a) a conforming app that lets non-partner staff lift walls would still pass, because wall_added_live only replays the walled person's own lift, which the brief already forbids ('nothing they do after that reaches it'); (b) a conforming app that reads seed from /assets rather than the /app copy still runs, because /assets is a verifier artifact; (c) a broken app that skips DB_PATH would lose its DB when /app is not writable, and the brief states DB_PATH explicitly, so that failure is fair. Non-blocking notes: sign-out is graded (signin_and_client_scope, refusal_in_place) but only implied by 'sign in as different people'. That is the skill's identity-surface house convention, not a defect. Wall authority reads 'Harriet can add or lift a wall' rather than 'only a partner', but no criterion grades a non-walled associate lifting walls. Unread sync across tabs within about 10 s is inferred from conv:25 + conv:33. This row is a source-contract review: I made no new runtime execution and did not use any judge or Oracle measurement, and I make no claim about portal checker output.
